summary: Solid code with strong Bash practices. Workflow well-structured with proper job dependencies and least-privilege permissions (contents: read only). Script has good error handling, argument parsing, and deterministic design. Minor issues: format help text lists only 'markdown'/'json' but accepts 'md' alias (L79); IFS= read pattern repeated per field (L116–121) could factor into helper; epoch math and jq usage lack explanatory comments; render functions are rigid—structural changes require manual updates to printf statements. Code is ready to ship with test harness in place.
